forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {装|よそお}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to pretend, to feign, to act as if
definitions.explanation: To act as if something is true or to present a false appearance. Often used for pretending not to know something or putting on a facade.

definitions.gloss: to dress up, to adorn, to decorate
definitions.explanation: To dress oneself or decorate something in a certain way. Often used for putting on formal attire or decorating for occasions.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧). Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ particle: ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{装|よそお}う.

CONJUGATION: Godan verb (wa-row): {装|よそお}わない, {装|よそお}います, {装|よそお}って.

NUANCE: For sense 1, {装|よそお}う implies deliberate pretense or putting on a facade. For sense 2, it has a more literary quality and is often used for formal or seasonal attire.

NOMINAL FORM: ⟦{装|よそお}い→装い：14044_yosooi⟧ (appearance, attire, decoration)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{平静|へいせい}→平静：16400_heisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{装|よそお}う (to feign composure)
- ～ふり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{装|よそお}う (to pretend to ~)
- ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{装|よそお}う (to dress oneself)
- ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧/⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{装|よそお}い→装い：14044_yosooi⟧ (autumn/spring attire)
